Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (Office of the Tahasildar, Ghasipura, Dist- Kendujhar, State- Odisha) ATC 1. Bidder must be an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or an authorised dealer of the OEM. 2. An undertaking from the OEM/ reseller is required stating that they would facilitate regularly with tec hnology/ product updates and extend all support for the warranty in confirmation with this tender for the quoted items. 3. Wherever authorised dealers are submitting bids, it is mandatory to submit the OEM bid-specific auth orisation certificate on Letter Head of OEM with name, seal, sign, contact no & email ID. 4. Bidder & OEM need to submit PAN, GST Certificate. 5. Dedicated /Toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/Toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Escalation Matrix for service support OEM must provide an Escalation Matrix with telephone numbers for service support. 7. A Notarized affidavit by the bidder that it has never been blacklisted by any Govt. Department & fun ded autonomous bodies must be uploaded along with the technical bid, failing which the bid shall be rejected. The same original bid-specific affidavit shall be submitted before the award of the bid by th e lowest evaluated successful OEM/bidder. 8. Certification: The OEM should have the following valid certificates and all the ISOs should be accredit ed from NABCB along with IAF-certified agency & the Bidder need to upload these in GeM portal duri ng the Bid Particiption. a) ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management system b) ISO 14001:2015- Environment Management System c) ISO 45001:2018 – Occupational Health and Safety Management System d) ISO 50001: 2018 – Energy Management System e) BIFMA compliance certificate of the OEM must be submitted, and the same shall be checke d on the BIFMA website (bifma.org), and at least 15 nos of products of the OEM should be e nlisted under BIFMA. (Furniture testing and certification) f) BIFMA LEVEL Certification-The Bidder/OEM should have furniture products certified und er BIFMA LEVEL, meeting any one of the following certification levels: BIFMA LEVEL 1 - Mini mum 6 certified products, or BIFMA LEVEL 2 - Minimum 6 certified products, or BIFMA LEVE L 3 - Minimum 6 certified products. Documentary evidence shall be submitted along with th e bid. (https://level.bifma.org/). g) IGBC Membership from CII h) Green Co. Certificate. i) GRIHA Certificate from Griha Council. j) Green Pro. by CII k) AIOTA for Education Furniture Range, Office Furniture including Seating Systems, Storage S

ystem rangeCertificate. The same shall be checked from the AIOTA website. l) The OEM must be producing furniture products certified under India Design Mark, with at le ast one product certified in each of the last three years (2023, 2024 & 2025). A screenshot from the official website (indiadesignmark.in) must be submitted as proof. 9. The bidder or its OEM shall submit the Manufacturing Factory License and Trademark certificate. A co py of both documents shall be enclosed as proof of compliance. 10. The bidder or its OEM must submit the BIS License copy for IS 17631:2022, IS 17632:2022, IS 17633: 2022, IS 17634:2022, and IS 17635:2022 as applicable as per the order of the Department for Promot ion of Industry and Internal Trade dated 13/02/2025. 11. OEM must have an OEM/OEM authorised service centre in Odisha. However, in case of the address of the OEM authorised service centre, proof of authorisation has to be produced on the OEM letterhead. 12. The OEM shall have a factory of its own for manufacturing the furniture and the factory shall cont ain the machinery mentioned below. Pipe Cutting Machine, CNC Tube/Pipe bending machine, Hydraulic Brake Press/ Mechanical Press, La zer Sheet Processing Machine/Lazer Cutting Machine, Post Forming Machine/Edge Banding Machine, Panel Saw Machine/ CNC Beam Saw Machine, Spindle Molder Machine, Multi Boring Machine, MIG / T IG Welding, In House Powder Coating Line with baking oven and powder application/ Automatic Powd er Coating Booth, CNCRouter Machine The OEM/Bidder should submit a Third-Party Feasibility Report regarding the machinery, w hich must be from any of the Inspection /certification bodies listed under NABCB. The same will be verified from the NABCB website. 13. A bid compliance undertaking must be submitted by the bidder/OEM citing that all items will be prov ided as per the attached specifications. 14. The product warranty will be one year for manufacturing defects. An undertaking from OEM on its Le tter Head should be produced. 15. Rates per unit of furniture must be quoted inclusive of supply & installation, transportation/delivery a t the site. 16. This is a bunch bid, so the bidder must quote for all the items; a single-item quotation will not be acc eptable. 17. Non- compliance of tender terms, non- uploading of required documents, lack of clarity of the specifi cations, supporting literature etc, contradiction & and submission of forged information may lead to rejection of the Bid. 18. The buyer reserves the right to accept/reject any/all bids without assigning any reasons therefore. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
